ticket.subject: Cancel our subscription
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

I look after our account at Kettlewick Ltd. We have decided to cancel our Scale subscription at the end of the current billing period.

We do not want the plan to renew automatically.

A reply in the next few days would be great. Please confirm the cancellation date in writing.

Best,
Bruno
